# Edge speech compatibility

`edge-gec-v2.mjs` is a server-side JavaScript adaptation of `src/edge_tts/drm.py`
from **edge-tts 7.3.1**, published October 13, 2026. Its source is LGPLv3; the
upstream license text is preserved in `edge-gec-LICENSE.txt`. The source remains
separate and editable. It is not copied to the Pages/browser payload.

Upstream: https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts

Verified PyPI wheel SHA-256:
`2a3c79d6235a7a736d681233823ce5492e829b43eb47beae49aa181237a8f9a4`.

Changes in this adaptation: use JavaScript unsigned arithmetic and `Math.imul`,
ordinary SHA round iteration instead of Python's unrolled optimization, BigInt
Windows ticks, and one cached five-minute token. The fixtures were generated by
the upstream Python implementation at six boundary/known times plus 32 seeded
random timestamps. They are public test vectors, not account credentials.

The provider now uses `Sec-MS-GEC-Version=2-143.0.3650.75` and a combined CS64 /
modified-SHA token. The old plain SHA-256/v1 algorithm is incompatible with this
contract. JennyNeural, MP3 output, SSML escaping and the existing request limits
are unchanged. This remains an unofficial consumer endpoint, not an availability
guarantee. If the corrected live request still fails, stop adding protocol guesses
and evaluate a supported speech service with Brady.
